label: Inputs: the folder, the Node version, integration tests
code:
inputs:
  working-directory:
    type: string
    required: true
  node-version:
    type: string
    default: "24"
  run-integration:
    type: boolean
    default: false

label: Outputs: the test coverage, for the caller
code:
outputs:
  coverage:
    description: Line coverage of the tests, in percent
    value: ${{ jobs.test.outputs.coverage }}

label: test: expose the coverage step's result
test: run commands in the caller's folder
test: the caller's Node version, with the npm cache
code:
- uses: actions/setup-node@v5
  with:
    node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}
    cache: npm
    cache-dependency-path: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}/package-lock.json

label: test: integration tests only when the caller asks
code:
- name: Integration tests
  if: inputs.run-integration
  run: npm run test:integration

label: Outputs: the test coverage, for the caller
code:
outputs:
  coverage:
    description: Line coverage of the tests, in percent
    value: ${{ steps.cov.outputs.pct }}

label: test: integration tests only when the caller asks
code:
- name: Integration tests
  if: inputs.run-integration == 'true'
  run: npm run test:integration

label: test: the caller's Node version, with the npm cache
code:
- uses: actions/setup-node@v5
  with:
    node-version: ${{ github.event.inputs.node-version }}
    cache: npm
    cache-dependency-path: ${{ github.event.inputs.working-directory }}/package-lock.json
